label: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor
about: Measures the distance to an object with sound pulses, from 2 cm to 4 m.
description: The module sends out a burst of sound that people cannot hear and waits for the echo. A microcontroller starts it with a pulse on one pin and times the answer on another pin. It reads from 2 cm to 4 m and misses soft or slanted surfaces.
